jobs.prompt: Match the paint handling and palette of the attached reference sheet. A wide landscape poster painting (3:2): a huge battered casino slot machine stands in the middle of an ancient Chinese battlefield, its lever pulled down, and out of its glowing-free dark reel window burst the four warlords from the reference (the red-faced long-bearded general, the black-bearded shouting general, the pale smirking lord, the warrior with pheasant feathers) tumbling out together with a flood of old bronze coins with square holes. Comic chaos, B-movie energy, dust and coins flying. Leave the top quarter of the image as a calm flat dark-red sky area with nothing in it (a title will be placed there later). No text anywhere.

A wide landscape image (3:2) used as a game battlefield, seen from a high bird's-eye view looking down at about 60 degrees. Stage: the Yellow Turban Rebellion, 184 AD. A flat rural plain of dry dirt and trampled wheat fields. Along the far left edge stands a rough wooden village palisade with a gate (the side being defended). Toward the right edge a few torn yellow cloth banners lie in the dirt. The large middle area is open, calm, simple ground with only broad flat paint strokes so small game pieces can be placed on top. No people, no soldiers, no animals, no text.
